value: Random-world bench sizing (gen-enemies-b1, 675 elite starts x 16 seeds, net @hpb0.01@tsl1 one turn deep, novelty = net HP-lost change minus the heuristic's, no ladder control): single-item cost mean +2.32 HP, sd between items 1.77 over 21 mechanics (+1.58, sd 2.76 over all 24); one item on 50 starts x 4 seeds has se about 0.73. Charter's literal read (k worlds vs 1.5 x k x the k=1 worlds' mean) puts additive only 0.7-2.4 se from the line at 20-40 worlds; the paired read (each world against the sum of its own items' singles, same starts and seeds) 5.3/7.9/11.5 se at k 2/4/8 with 20 worlds on 21 items. Saturation: summed single raw costs exceed start HP on 12%/37%/77% of starts at k 2/4/8. Pilot about 0.6 thread-h.
